purpose: Mandatory construction and inherited workflow checklist, not fixed domain features or completed evidence. Bind each future target to its actual request and domain-specific acceptance.

items.title: Natural-language intake
items.acceptance: Identify intent, desired outcome, current state and permitted scope from exact sources. A user can start without knowing skill or script names.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Resume existing work
items.acceptance: Read current files, versions, rights and decisions. Preserve originals and accepted decisions and report concrete gaps.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Domain neutrality
items.acceptance: Installable reusable sources carry no example-specific names, entities, preset features or prepared scenarios from the user's illustrative list.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Adaptive clarification
items.acceptance: Derive questions from concrete gaps and affected decisions. Explain why each matters, options, consequences and the dependent blocker.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Reconstruct the domain independently
items.acceptance: Map users and roles, objects, processes, states, integrations, risks, constraints and outcomes from actual intent and evidence. Look beyond known templates.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Requirements coverage
items.acceptance: Trace stable ID through source and intent, priority and applicability, dependencies, owner, acceptance, artifact, evidence and closure. Define child checks for compound requirements.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Preserve essential goals
items.acceptance: Carry the core promise through discovery, alternatives, design, implementation, verification and operations. Treat every required failure as a gate.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Strong alternatives and evidence
items.acceptance: Compare candidate and existing alternatives using the same appropriate criteria. Distinguish facts, assumptions and conclusions.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Complete agent specification before construction
items.acceptance: Provide a versioned blueprint with capabilities, inputs and outputs, operation, limits, roles, tools, stages, tests, handoff, spending, rights and unknowns.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Blueprint approval
items.acceptance: Bind actual approval to exact version, digest and scope. Pending, declined or stale decisions block dependent construction. Route material scope changes to the owning decision.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Proportionate architecture
items.acceptance: Compare a cohesive module and a family where decomposition has benefit. Derive module count from this task.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Domain specialists and independent review
items.acceptance: Assign actual leads and contributors with inputs, owned paths, outputs and gates. Independent checks come from actual different actors.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Dependencies and parallel work
items.acceptance: Map stages, tasks, artifacts and external prerequisites. Parallelize independent work and serialize authority, shared mutations and dependencies.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Verified tools and environments
items.acceptance: Report tested, unknown and blocked capabilities, with versions, permissions, budget and compatibility. Verify named hosts and plugins through actual capabilities.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Prepare required infrastructure
items.acceptance: Set up only needed environments, accounts, workspace, integrations and authority. Execute available authorized automation and isolate the exact personal owner action.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Construction and installation
items.acceptance: Build actual skills, resources and scripts for accepted competencies. Verify packages and actual persistence and installation independently from ZIP delivery.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Work and Codex portability
items.acceptance: Maintain one controlled source, portable forms based on host capabilities, and independently usable modules without hidden sibling dependencies. Distinguish source, version, installation, discovery and execution.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: End-to-end handoff packets
items.acceptance: Each boundary carries actual inputs and outputs, hashes, decisions, facts, evidence and gaps, readable next action and a return contract.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Actual launch of the result
items.acceptance: Give a working route to launch and see the result in the requested environment. Record observed receipt, URL, build or process, or a specific blocked handoff.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Project knowledge and adaptation
items.acceptance: Record sources, confidence, scope, applicability and impact for new requirements and lessons. Reconcile and invalidate affected evidence before dependent jobs. Derive rights from current authority.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Project-local specialization
items.acceptance: Produce project-local knowledge, templates, scripts or skills where needed within accepted scope. Route material additions to the owning decision.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Pause and resume
items.acceptance: Pause now, after an artifact or after a stage as directed. Record finished, current and pending work, effects and next action. Carry the stop boundary forward and preserve completed work.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Checks and accurate statuses
items.acceptance: Distinguish structural validation, self-check, independent review, owner acceptance, build, running state, deployment and observed operation. Include negative cases and bounded local repair.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Operations and evolution
items.acceptance: Provide runbook, supported monitoring, incident response, recovery and rollback, versions and migrations, feedback and metrics. Route changes to affected branches.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Complete user guide
items.acceptance: Cover getting started, installation, natural-language use, approvals, Work and Codex handoff, launch and return, pause and resume, update and recovery, and operating the final product.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Separate scopes for the factory, generated agent, and final product
items.acceptance: Establish package creation and product execution independently. Carry authority only within its valid scope.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Project and private knowledge isolation
items.acceptance: Generalize methods where appropriate. Use another project's credentials, private data or decisions only with applicable authorization.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Source/permission/effect ledger
items.acceptance: Bind creation, spending, publication, destructive changes and recurring jobs to current exact scope and actual receipts.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Unknown-outcome reconciliation and idempotency
items.acceptance: After timeout, read authoritative status and reconcile. Retry only within authority after the outcome is known.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Realistic completeness
items.acceptance: Cover known applicable requirements in bounded scope. Assign future details owners and due gates. Avoid a claim like «Абсолютно все в усіх майбутніх світах».
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Resource discipline
items.acceptance: Bound time, tokens, generations, storage, spend and concurrency. Run cheaper sufficient checks first and stop when the agreed criteria are met.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Safe import and exact source preservation
items.acceptance: Check paths, symlinks, resource limits and provenance. Keep imported scripts inactive until controlled execution is appropriate. Preserve accepted originals.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Knowledge and context control
items.acceptance: Default to files, structured or lexical lookup, dependencies and readable checkpoints. Add SDKs, vector stores or longer chains where measured need justifies them.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Cross-layer consistency
items.acceptance: Preserve accepted value, behavior, interaction, identity and quality from specs through materials, code and operations.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: Actual environment boundaries
items.acceptance: Verify the LLM, host, secrets, permission, background operation and quality evidence independently from framework or script presence.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifact plus appropriate actual evidence/review; source text alone is not proof

items.title: M0/M1/M2 maturity levels
items.acceptance: Sketch, complete passport, and exact production handoff have distinct due gates. Give complete alternatives comparable coverage.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Domain systems model
items.acceptance: Describe entities, definitions, instances and revisions, actors, states, causal reads, writes and events, and applicability for the actual domain.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Executable rules
items.acceptance: Specify types, units, constraints, order, rounding, capture point, time, probability, priority and independent oracle. Resolve behavior before implementation.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Failure and recovery
items.acceptance: Define normal, partial, blocked, cancelled, unknown and recovery transitions, allowed actions, cleanup, consequences and recovery.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Durable state
items.acceptance: Define authority, persistence, consistency groups, durable boundaries, migration, rollback and restore, tombstones and a crash corpus.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: End-to-end production graph
items.acceptance: Trace requirement → contract → operation → recipe → transformation → attempt → output → consumer assembly → evidence. Give edges causal meaning and check dependent coverage.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Operation-level capability
items.acceptance: Record descriptor, schema, catalog, access, tested operation and integration independently. Unsupported material parameters remain open.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Actual parameter consumption
items.acceptance: Bind each material requirement to its actual schema field, value, supported operation and consumer check.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Semantic transformations
items.acceptance: Verify source, master, export, consumer, IDs, encoding, units, time, precision and privacy. Record preserved invariants and allowed losses with oracles.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Production recipes
items.acceptance: Pin exact inputs and hashes, step DAG, owner and consumer, masters and output formats, validators, budgets, effects, repair and stopping condition. Bind templates before execution.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Attempt history
items.acceptance: Record pending before effect, actual job and receipt, append observations and cost, and reconcile unknown outcomes before retry. Verify provider exactly-once behavior when claimed.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Causal repair
items.acceptance: Record failure group, hypothesis, changed variable, expected correction, next validator and cap. Change method after two equivalent failures.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Semantic cache
items.acceptance: Include relevant inputs, recipe, model, toolchain, profile and rights. Invalidate affected proof after source, schema, terms or importer changes.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Actual assembly
items.acceptance: Pin component, configuration and inputs, run a real consumer scenario, and record structural, semantic, integration, human and operational verdicts separately.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Measured capacity
items.acceptance: Prove a representative end-to-end element before scaling. Record observed time, cost, repair and bottlenecks and scope projections to evidence.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Child-agent inheritance
items.acceptance: Each module carries versioned core, domain, production and evaluation contracts, exact requirements coverage, recipes and fixtures, and a handoff a fresh receiver can run.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Exact host handback
items.acceptance: Provide preflight, cwd, inputs and digest, steps, receipt, return validation and next permitted action. Verify Work and Codex sessions separately.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Current formats and evidence freshness
items.acceptance: Version supported formats independently of the toolkit. Reject unsupported formats and reproduce new results from current sources with current evidence.
items.closure_requires: current scoped artifacts, exact links/hashes and actual evidence of required kind; structural pass alone is not domain quality

items.title: Conditional specialist skill construction
items.acceptance: Use current design-specialist-skills when reusable skills or a methodology gap require it, within exact accepted scope. Use Skill Creator for installation. For code or configuration only, use a constructor when justified. Carry existing discovery and approval forward. Record unavailable dependencies accurately.
items.closure_requires: current scoped route/handoff artifacts, actual dependency resolution and evidence; catalog or structural pass alone does not prove invocation or domain quality

items.title: Domain routing for app and chatbot components
items.acceptance: For chosen app and bot components use stable Work @ or Codex $ family selectors, portable bounded handoff, parent authority and requirements and scope, shared contract owner and consumers and hash, actual skill resolution and execution proof. Keep unchosen components open and maintain one source of truth across the combined product.
items.closure_requires: current scoped route/handoff artifacts, actual dependency resolution and evidence; catalog or structural pass alone does not prove invocation or domain quality

rules: Validate each due applicable must individually; never average away a failing requirement.
Preserve actual source and emphasized intent across phases and outputs.
Unknown domain details require explained discovery; do not populate from illustrative presets.
Current user approval of exact target blueprint precedes target construction.
Factory design, target execution and external effects have separate scopes.
This checklist states obligations; files or filled records alone prove no product quality.
current_protocol_note: One current protocol per record kind; toolkit version and protocol version are independent. Previous output format adapters are not provided.
